facts.fact: Amel Djouamaa of Algeria's Interior Ministry says the national addressing system has so far recorded 1.5 million official unified, geolocatable addresses, rolled out in 12 wilayas, with 13 more to follow once funded in the 2026 state budget and all 69 wilayas by 2030.

facts.fact: The article names users of the addressing system at the Oran study day as the security services, Protection civile, Sonelgaz, the tax services and Algerienne des eaux, with practical applications presented from Oran communes.
